Bill.BriefDescription: Eliminating the prevent or reduce owneroccupied foreclosure program account.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to eliminating the prevent or reduce owneroccupiedforeclosure program account; creating a new section; repealing RCW43.320.160, 43.320.165, and 43.320.170; and repealing 2009 c 386 s 5(uncodified).
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 43.320.160 (Prevent or reduce owneroccupied foreclosureprogramReport) and 2009 c 386 s 1 & 2008 c 322 s 1; RCW 43.320.165 (Prevent or reduce owneroccupied foreclosureprogram account) and 2009 c 386 s 2 & 2008 c 322 s 2; RCW 43.320.170 (Prevent or reduce owneroccupied foreclosureprogramHouseholds served) and 2009 c 386 s 3 & 2008 c 322 s 3; and 2009 c 386 s 5 (uncodified).

No later than December 31, 2010, the statetreasurer shall transfer to the Washington financial education publicprivate partnership account the unexpended balance of the prevent or p. 1 SB 6442reduce owneroccupied foreclosure program account as of the effectivedate of this section.
